newsitem.title: USA: Boardwalk gains more land on Vegas Strip.
newsitem.headline: Boardwalk gains more land on Vegas Strip.

text.p: Boardwalk Casino Inc said Monday it has signed a lease and option to buy one acre of land on the Las Vegas Strip for an undisclosed sum.
The acre is adjacent to and north of the Boardwalk Hotel & Casino and gives it an additional 150 feet fronting the Strip.
"This site gives us room for future growth when we are just beginning to contemplate expanding our room base and casino size," Forrest Woodward, president, said in a statement.
Boardwalk Casino Inc owns and operates a 654-room Holiday Inn franchise and a 33,000-square-foot casino on the Strip.
